name: Vee Laser
main_effect: [Main] Trash the top 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if you have a green Digimon in play, you may play 1 level 4 or lower blue Digimon card with the [Free] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effects.
